Automation.Name: Automation Mode
Automation.Hint: Choose how the module interacts with character sheets.

HpAutomation.Name: Max HP Trigger
HpAutomation.Hint: Define behavior when HP reaches maximum (Death).

BlazeMessage.Name: Text: Blaze of Glory
BlazeMessage.Hint: The message displayed in chat when Blaze of Glory is chosen.

ShowProbabilities.Name: Show Probabilities
ShowProbabilities.Hint: If checked, displays the percentage chance of outcomes below each death option.

ItemSources.Name: Supported Items
ItemSources.Hint: Which item each automation watches for. Matched by source, not by name.
ItemSources.Label: Configure Items
ItemSources.Title: Death Moves: Supported Items
ItemSources.Intro: Each slot holds the item the automation looks for. Matching is done by source, so a renamed or translated copy on a character sheet still works. Drag an item from a compendium or a character sheet onto a slot to change it.
ItemSources.Assigned: Death Moves: slot now set to {item}.
ItemSources.DropItemOnly: Death Moves: drop an Item here.
ItemSources.DropUnresolved: Death Moves: that item could not be read.

Risk.Title: Risk it All
Risk.Subtitle: Death or Legend
Risk.DistributeHint: Distribute {total} points to reduce HP and/or Stress.
Risk.HeroplateSlider: Spend Hope for a bigger Hope Die

HeroplateBlocked.Unequipped: Equip the armor to spend Hope

Items.sprite: Clears all Hit Points. Spends the item.
Items.tears: One final action roll, then a slumber. Spends the item.
Items.Gone: Death Moves: that item is no longer available.

Risk.Speaker: Risk It All
Risk.HopeDesc: You stand, clearing Hit Points and/or Stress equal to the Hope Die value.
Risk.CriticalDesc: You stand and clear all Hit Points and Stress.

Sprite.Title: THE BOTTLE SHATTERS
Sprite.Desc: A Sprite bursts free and clears every Hit Point from {actor} before fading from the Mortal Realm.

Tears.Title: DEATH CANNOT TOUCH YOU
Tears.Desc: {actor} takes one final action roll, then falls into a dreamless slumber. Only an ally's Tend to Wounds downtime move will clear those Hit Points.

phoenix.Label: Phoenix Feather
phoenix.Hint: Grants +1 to the Avoid Death roll.

reliquary.Label: Reliquary of the Sightless Saint
reliquary.Hint: Grants +1 to the Hope Die on Risk It All.

heroplate.Label: Hallowed Heroplate
heroplate.Hint: Equipped armor whose Blessed feature lets you spend Hope to raise the Hope Die on Risk It All, once per long rest.

tears.Label: Tears of the Undying Hero
tears.Hint: Carried, not drunk in advance. Replaces the death move with one final action roll and a dreamless slumber, and is consumed.

sprite.Label: Sprite Bottle
sprite.Hint: Shatters on the last Hit Point, clears them all, and is consumed. No death move happens.

Trigger.Title: Trigger Death Moves
Trigger.Hint: This will send the Death Moves screen to the selected player.

Scar.Title: Select a Scar
Scar.Hint: Choose the permanent cost this survival carried.

Experience.Title: Negative Experience
Experience.Hint: Describe the Negative Experience this scar leaves behind.
Experience.Name: Name

Notifications.GmOnly: Death Moves: only the GM can trigger this.
Notifications.AutomationFailed: Death Moves: automation failed. See the console for details.
Notifications.ItemFailed: Death Moves: item automation failed. See the console for details.
Notifications.SystemAutomationOff: Death Moves: system death move automation disabled (Core mode active).
Notifications.NotAssigned: Death Moves: this character is not the one assigned to you.
Notifications.NoActiveGM: Death Moves: no GM is connected to send the Death Moves screen.
Notifications.Requested: Death Moves: your request was sent to the GM.
